# AI 原生组织（AI-Native Organization）

> 免费公开、持续更新的开源书：哪些组织真的把 AI 长成了组织基因，而不是给老组织贴创可贴。

Models are no longer scarce; people who can grow models into their organizations are. This free, continuously
updated book studies "AI-native organizations" — what they are, what the empirical evidence says, and how to
build one — with sourced cases from China and globally.

- 作者 / Author：Jweokk｜在线阅读 / Read online：https://aiorg.fly2ai.top
- 双语 / Languages：中文 10 章（站点 + `book/`）· English 10 chapters（`book-en/` + PDF）
- 许可 / License：非商业分享（正文 CC BY-NC-SA 4.0）；商用须书面许可
- 更新 / Updates：自动合并新素材持续增补，版本历史见附录 C / `CHANGELOG.md`
